svg.text: AD5M / PSU TERMINALS AND POWER DISTRIBUTION
A-350GF-24-CX | label rating: 24 V DC, 14.6 A | your actual PSU photo
Terminal numbering below is added for this drawing; read left to right in the photo.
Both screws share the same output.
Both screws share the same return.
do not infer them from wire colors.
-> ReliaBot DC IN + / - using 12 AWG copper
-> Positive / negative DC distribution blocks using 12 AWG
Use suitably rated terminals, branch protection and covered connections.
MOSFET HOT BED + -> FPC pins 12-22 combined
MOSFET HOT BED - -> FPC pins 1-11 combined
FPC 23 -> Octopus PROBE DC (5 V); FPC 28 -> GND
PSU rating is 14.6 A total, shared by all loads.
Distribution hardware: rated for at least 14.6 A.
Branch fuse sizes remain to be selected.
FPC 23 requires 5 V, never PSU 24 V. FPC 26 -> probe signal PC5. Pi uses kit adapter.
-V is the DC return; it does not replace protective earth. Do not add an earth-to--V bond based on this drawing.
Set the input-voltage selector for your mains while unplugged: 115 V for 120 V supply; 230 V for 230 V supply.
Preserve the stock AC switch / fuse / protective-earth arrangement. Refit the terminal cover before operation.
Annotations identify terminal functions; leader-line colors are not a mains-wire color code.
Terminal order is read from the photographed label. Electrical checks and first power-up remain pending.
